description: Writes the design spec for a game or a feature: core loop, player verbs, mechanics, win and lose conditions, progression structure. Turns a settled direction into something precise enough to build from. Prose and diagrams, not numbers and not code.
when_to_use: a direction is agreed and has to be written down as a spec
people disagree about how a mechanic actually works
a feature needs defining before anyone writes code
avoid_when: the direction is still being argued rather than recorded
the request is about tuning numbers in a mechanic that is already specified
